title: PSRM protest at ANRE over proposed gas tariff increase
location: In front of the National Agency for Energy Regulation (ANRE), Chișinău.
scope: PSRM supporters held an actual protest while ANRE considered a proposed gas-tariff increase. TV8 reports chants calling for ANRE's resignation, the government's resignation and early parliamentary elections; a government spokesperson said compensation would be offered to reduce the effect of higher tariffs.
organizer: Party of Socialists of the Republic of Moldova (PSRM).
threshold_50_evidence: TV8 reports supporters protesting but gives no numerical or qualitative crowd estimate. The ≥50 simultaneous threshold remains unresolved.

start_date.summary: Both TV8 and UNIMEDIA date the protest to 29 November 2024.

location.summary: Both reports place the action at ANRE in Chișinău.

organizer.summary: TV8 and UNIMEDIA identify PSRM and its supporters/members.

demands.summary: Both reports connect the protest to gas tariff increases and report demands including ANRE/government resignations; TV8 also reports calls for early elections.

participants_original.summary: Neither opened body gives a participant count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Both opened reports describe the protest but do not establish 50 simultaneous participants.

state_response.summary: Government spokesperson said authorities would provide compensation to lessen the effect of higher tariffs; whether this constitutes accommodation is unresolved.

protester_violence.summary: Neither report describes protester violence; value remains unknown.

notes: Only one account was opened for event-level facts. Related PSRM and wire reports remain search-only and are not treated as independent corroboration.
open_questions: How many people were present simultaneously?
Was the proposed tariff increase approved and did the compensation address a protest demand?
Is this action linked to another PSRM energy protest, or a distinct event?
